text:
angela: Quick heads-up — proposing to lift the runtime pin for runtime-v3 on eu-dedicated so we can route llama-embed-v2 as the default for embeddings. Goal: cut token cost and reduce cross-region fallbacks. Planned window: 2026-03-25T09:00Z -> 10:00Z. Need sign-off + rollback/runbook before we touch prod.

samir: Do we have an SDK compatibility matrix for this? Last time older SDKs hit a KV-cache shim issue. Which client versions are impacted?

jun: On canary we saw a small tail increase for the quantized variant on long sequences — p99 from ~210ms -> ~240ms, error rate stable. Not a blocker but we should gate by traffic % and have a fast re-pin.

maya: If we lift the pin, let's do a phased canary: 5% for 10m, 25% for 10m, then 100%. Auto rollback criteria: errors > 1% OR p99 increase > 20% vs baseline. Also require a routing fallback to runtime:v2.14 for sequences >1024 tokens.

angela: Plan to add a small eval set to Redwood Console (embeddings smoke) and attach it to the rollout so quality/regression alerts are live. @samir please confirm SDK compatibility, @jun please create the alert and temporary routing rule.

samir: Quick check: SDK clients >=2.9 have native kv-cache handling for runtime-v3. SDK 2.7 and 2.8 need the shim header. Workaround for older clients: set header `X-Runtime-Shim: compat-2.7` at the gateway. I'll post a short note for the devex changelog.

angela: Noted. We should also document the rollback command for on-call.

maya: Suggested rollback snippet for runbook: 
```
# Re-pin runtime and force 100% split to v2.14
/deploy re-pin runtime:v2.14 --env=eu-dedicated --force-split=100 --reason="rollback:runtime-v3-unpin"
```

jun: I'll create the alert rules: `p99-latency-eu >= baseline*1.2 for 3m` and `errors-eu >= 1% for 1m`. Also adding routing rule: `if embed.seq_len > 1024 -> runtime:v2.14` for the window. I'll monitor the canary and be on-call during the window.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by angela: action=unpin runtime:v3 target=eu-dedicated window=2026-03-25T09:00Z/2026-03-25T10:00Z canary=5% (10m) -> 25% (10m) -> 100% (remaining). rollback_cmd set. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/unpin-runtime-v3

samir: Added SDK compatibility note to release notes draft and devex ticket. Will post client header guidance and snippet.

angela: Approved from product side. :thumbsup: We'll proceed with the staged canary and jun will trigger rollback if alerts fire. Thank you everyone.

deploy-bot: Reminder: rollback timer=10m after lift if auto-conditions met. Notification channels: #eng-oncall, #eng-releases.
